answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A new agent docks at the network wharf and posts 200 POA into escrow. It must keep a steady pulse of real tasks, each signed with its own quill, building a fingerprint over 20 epochs. Faking 1000 prints is ruinous: 1,000 fakes lock 200,000 POA and need 30 days of behavior each, more than fakes earn. An honest agent pays once, unlocks its bond after 20 honest epochs, and earns trust.
